title: LTB-REMEDIATE-P3: evaluator-backed fail-closed authority for seven governed output routes
intent: On base 8d5a3a2a (merge of #402), make the seven remaining governed manufacturing routes consult compute_feasibility_internal and SafetyPolicy before program construction. Unresolved tool ids fail closed with HTTP 409. No new evaluators, no retract refactor, no CF-4 work.
behavior_change: The seven governed routes change from HTTP 200 with a self-minted GREEN artifact to HTTP 409 SAFETY_BLOCKED when no qualified evaluator exists. Draft siblings are unchanged.

diff_articulation.what_changed: A shared require_manufacturing_output_authority service calls compute_feasibility_internal, SafetyPolicy.extract_safety_decision, and SafetyPolicy.should_block before any of the seven routes build output. A block persists a BLOCKED run with no gcode_sha256 and raises HTTP 409. Permitted test fixtures persist the evaluator decision through persist_authorized_manufacturing_output. Polygon offset, geometry export, and the five probe downloads use that sequence. The audit registry rows for polygon-offset, probing, and geometry now say BLOCKED_BY_DESIGN with status NONE and evaluator null. Retract is untouched.
diff_articulation.why: Those seven governed routes generated a program and then constructed RunDecision(risk_level=GREEN). Persistence, hashes, simulation, and the _governed suffix were being treated as manufacturing authority.
diff_articulation.why_not_redundant: Retract already fails closed through _authorize_retract. These seven routes did not. The new service copies that sequence without moving the retract implementation.
diff_articulation.what_did_not_change: No resolve_mode prefixes. No placeholder or real evaluators. No retract source change. Draft siblings /polygon_offset.nc, /export_gcode, and the plain probe JSON and draft downloads still emit. CF-4 / #401, P-1 and P-2 readiness, authentication, and generator qualification are untouched. The registry is not read at runtime.
diff_articulation.why_structural_extraction: The seven handlers share one pre-generation refusal so none of them can mint a decision. Probe response construction stays a separate helper that only accepts an authority context.

proofs: Unresolved tool ids boss_probe_gcode, corner_probe_gcode, pocket_probe_gcode, surface_z_probe_gcode, vise_square_probe_gcode, geometry_export_gcode, and cam_polygon_offset_nc take the unavailable_feasibility path and SafetyPolicy blocks with HTTP 409 before generation.
Blocked responses contain no G/M program records, no attachment, and no X-GCode-SHA256. The blocked artifact has status BLOCKED and hashes.gcode_sha256 is null.
A non-autouse test fixture that returns GREEN is the only permitting path. The persisted decision risk_level and warnings match that fixture. Production requests without the fixture stay 409.
Simulation pass, simulation override, and RMOS_REQUIRE_SIMULATION disabled do not bypass a blocked authority decision. Permission without the simulation gate is still HTTP 403.
AST order rejects generation, RunDecision(GREEN), and attachment construction before the authority call. The seven target modules contain no RunDecision(risk_level='GREEN') literal.
The nine-route census matches the two retract aliases plus the seven targets and fails when empty, missing, or extended. Draft siblings are listed and are not in that population.
verification.hardware: No physical-machine execution. No generated program was sent to a machine.
